proof_inputs.current_prefix_invariant: Every canonical length-32 current word begins with MAGIC, so prefix_16(y)[3]=MAGIC[3]=0.

hand_derivation: The frozen selector proves that every canonical length-30 UNSAT-capable parent has v=1,m=3. The raw encoding length is 30, so there is no pad.
For v=1 the literal width is one and every variable-index bit is exactly 1. The 12-bit header is MAGIC || gamma(1) || gamma(3) = 111001011011.
The equal split occurs three payload bits after that header. Writing the nine literal signs as s1,...,s9, the suffix c is 1,s3,1,s4,1,s5,1,s6,1,s7,1,s8,1,s9,1.
Therefore the literal-transpose row label 1||c has zero-indexed bit 3 equal to 1, independently of every sign and independently of whether the parent formula is SAT or UNSAT.
Every canonical current word begins with MAGIC=11100101. Hence every length-16 canonical prefix has zero-indexed bit 3 equal to 0, including both frozen length-32 parameter regimes.

Thus exact equality 1||c=prefix_16(y) is impossible for every canonical length-30 parent and every canonical length-32 current word. A fortiori it is impossible for the canonical-UNSAT parent subset H_15.
candidate_conclusion: H_15 intersection P_16 is empty under the unchanged C041 grammar and C048 swapped reduction.

difference_witness_vs_c049_k12.shared_family: fixed payload/header bit incompatibility after equal split
difference_witness_vs_c049_k12.changed_coordinate: k=12 mismatch was at zero-indexed label bit 4; k=15 split phase shifts the forced parent variable-index bit to zero-indexed label bit 3.
difference_witness_vs_c049_k12.nontransfer_statement: The k=12 bit position was not assumed. The k=15 bit position is rederived from the frozen v=1,m=3 parse and equal split.

falsifiers: a canonical length-30 parent outside v=1,m=3
a legal v=1 literal whose width-one variable-index bit is not 1
a different equal-split suffix start than payload position 3
a canonical length-32 word whose zero-indexed prefix bit 3 is not MAGIC[3]=0
one exact canonical pair with 1||c equal to prefix_16(y)
any silent change to grammar, split, label map, or C048 swapped reduction

expert_cell.finding: The contradiction is syntactic and uniform over the whole canonical parent regime, so UNSAT semantics need not be invoked after the fixed-bit clash is established.
The synchronized-code analogy is useful only to expose the shared coordinate; it contributes no theorem authority and no semantic UNSAT claim.
Recompute the split phase and MAGIC indexing independently; an off-by-one error is the cheapest decisive falsifier.
Bind zero-indexing, header length 12, suffix start at payload position 3, and unchanged C048 label/reduction explicitly before result promotion.

At most a decoder-specific representation/compositional lemma; repeated finite fixed-bit failures should reroute toward a parametric split-phase compatibility screen rather than another blind finite-k scan.
